official_results.fight: Norbert Novenyi Jr. vs Theo Haig

lessons: Method model failed to distinguish finish weapon from actual access/conversion; Week 7 exact winner+method was 0-5.
Haig anomaly confirms conditional method probabilities require career-route plausibility and out-of-distribution checks.
Dasuyev and Guaylupo were correctly picked to win but finished by decision, so undefeated/high-finish-rate priors overestimated conversion against durable opponents.
Degli side was correct but finish family was wrong; grappling dominance and back-taking access should raise SUB probability even for high-KO finishers.
Piwowarczyk-Quissua miss: size/durability/late-round momentum reversal and opponent pressure resilience were underweighted in winner and method routing.
O/U threshold directions were strong at 12-3, but logical-monotonicity issues remain; keep duration model shadow until coherent survival/hazard architecture replaces independent thresholds.
Exact round remains weak; do not promote despite 2-3 bucket grade.
